description.zh: 流量分发配置，支持配置一个或两个流程版本。当指定别名发起执行时，系统会根据权重选择对应的流程版本进行执行。
description.en: The traffic distribution configuration for one or two flow versions. When you start an execution using the alias, the system uses the specified weights to select a flow version to execute.

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明
- 每个用户所能创建的流程个数受资源限制（详见[使用限制](~~122093~~)），如果您有特殊需求，可以提工单进行调整。
- 流程在用户级别是按照名称来区分的，即单一账号下不可以存在同名流程。
descriptions.en:
## API description

- The number of flows that you can create is limited by resources. For more information, see [Limits](~~122093~~). If you have special requirements, you can submit a ticket to request an adjustment.

- Each flow must have a unique name within your account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun fnf create-flow-alias --flow-name example-flow-name --name example-alias-name --description example_description --routing-configurations Version=1 Weight=30 --region cn-hangzhou
